subject.title: feat: add codexbar guard — quota-aware exit code to gate automation

question: Should CodexBar support `guard` as a stable public automation contract, including its provider/window naming and documented exit-code semantics?
rationale: This is a new CLI capability whose exit statuses will become script dependencies; the implementation can be repaired mechanically, but the durable scope and compatibility promise need maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow guard contract
options.body: Keep the documented single-provider threshold and primary/secondary-window scope, then require the fallback repair and real configured-account proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow or defer the public API
options.body: Reduce the supported provider/window semantics or close the feature direction before a stable automation contract is published.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow guard contract
recommendation.body: Keep the documented single-provider threshold and primary/secondary-window scope, then require the fallback repair and real configured-account proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent direct commits on the PR cover the guard contract and credential behavior.
